title: Form Builder Interface - Core Builder with Drag-and-Drop
description:
## Overview
Implement the core form builder interface that allows users to create and edit forms with a visual drag-and-drop experience. This is the heart of the application.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router)
- **State Management**: Zustand (for builder state)
- **Drag & Drop**: @dnd-kit/core
- **UI Components**: Shadcn UI
- **Animations**: framer-motion
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS

## Features to Implement

### 1. Builder Layout
- [ ] Split view layout (sidebar + canvas + preview panel)
- [ ] Responsive design (collapse panels on smaller screens)
- [ ] Resizable panels with drag handles
- [ ] Dark/Light mode support

### 2. Question Sidebar
- [ ] Collapsible question type categories
- [ ] Search/filter questions in sidebar
- [ ] Drag question types from sidebar to canvas
- [ ] Visual indicators for question types (icons)
- [ ] Tooltip descriptions for each type

### 3. Canvas (Main Editor Area)
- [ ] Drop zone for questions
- [ ] Visual placeholder when dragging over canvas
- [ ] Empty state with call-to-action
- [ ] Question cards with:
  - Question number/index
  - Question type indicator
  - Question title (editable inline)
  - Required indicator
  - Drag handle
  - Quick actions (duplicate, delete)
  - Expand/collapse for settings

### 4. Drag-and-Drop Implementation (@dnd-kit/core)
- [ ] DndContext provider setup
- [ ] Sortable list for question reordering
- [ ] Draggable question types from sidebar
- [ ] Droppable canvas zones
- [ ] Drag overlay (ghost preview while dragging)
- [ ] Collision detection strategy
- [ ] Keyboard accessibility for DnD
- [ ] Smooth animations during drag

### 5. Zustand Store Structure
```typescript
interface FormBuilderStore {
  // Form metadata
  form: Form | null;
  
  // Questions
  questions: Question[];
  selectedQuestionId: string | null;
  
  // Actions
  addQuestion: (type: QuestionType, index?: number) => void;
  updateQuestion: (id: string, updates: Partial<Question>) => void;
  deleteQuestion: (id: string) => void;
  duplicateQuestion: (id: string) => void;
  reorderQuestions: (activeId: string, overId: string) => void;
  selectQuestion: (id: string | null) => void;
  
  // Undo/Redo
  history: HistoryState[];
  historyIndex: number;
  undo: () => void;
  redo: () => void;
  
  // UI State
  previewMode: 'desktop' | 'tablet' | 'mobile';
  setPreviewMode: (mode: PreviewMode) => void;
}
```

### 6. Real-time Preview Panel
- [ ] Desktop/Tablet/Mobile toggle
- [ ] Device frame mockups
- [ ] Live preview of form as respondent sees it
- [ ] Sync with builder state
- [ ] Scroll to selected question in preview

### 7. Autosave
- [ ] Debounced autosave (save after 2s of inactivity)
- [ ] Save indicator (Saving... / Saved / Error)
- [ ] Conflict resolution for concurrent edits
- [ ] Optimistic updates with rollback on error

### 8. Undo/Redo
- [ ] History stack implementation
- [ ] Keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+Z, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z)
- [ ] Undo/Redo buttons in toolbar
- [ ] History limit (e.g., 50 actions)

## API Endpoints Required
```
GET    /api/forms/:id          - Fetch form with questions
PUT    /api/forms/:id          - Update form metadata
POST   /api/forms/:id/questions - Add question
PUT    /api/questions/:id       - Update question
DELETE /api/questions/:id       - Delete question
POST   /api/forms/:id/reorder   - Reorder questions
```

## Database Schema (Drizzle)
```typescript
// forms table
export const forms = pgTable('forms', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  userId: uuid('user_id').notNull().references(() => users.id),
  workspaceId: uuid('workspace_id').references(() => workspaces.id),
  title: varchar('title', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  description: text('description'),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 20 }).default('draft'),
  settings: jsonb('settings'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at').defaultNow(),
});

// questions table
export const questions = pgTable('questions', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  formId: uuid('form_id').notNull().references(() => forms.id),
  type: varchar('type', { length: 50 }).notNull(),
  title: text('title'),
  description: text('description'),
  required: boolean('required').default(false),
  order: integer('order').notNull(),
  settings: jsonb('settings'),
  validations: jsonb('validations'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at').defaultNow(),
});
```

## File Structure
```
src/
├── app/
│   └── (dashboard)/
│       └── forms/
│           └── [formId]/
│               └── edit/
│                   └── page.tsx        # Builder page
├── components/
│   └── builder/
│       ├── BuilderLayout.tsx
│       ├── QuestionSidebar.tsx
│       ├── BuilderCanvas.tsx
│       ├── PreviewPanel.tsx
│       ├── QuestionCard.tsx
│       ├── DragOverlay.tsx
│       └── question-types/
│           ├── index.ts
│           └── [each-type].tsx
├── stores/
│   └── builder-store.ts
├── hooks/
│   ├── useFormBuilder.ts
│   └── useAutosave.ts
└── lib/
    └── dnd/
        └── sensors.ts
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] User can drag question types from sidebar to canvas
- [ ] User can reorder questions via drag-and-drop
- [ ] User can delete and duplicate questions
- [ ] Changes are autosaved
- [ ] Undo/Redo works correctly
- [ ] Preview updates in real-time
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works
- [ ] Mobile responsive

## Dependencies
- Must have authentication system in place
- Must have database schema set up
- Must have basic form CRUD API

## Estimated Effort
Large (2-3 days)
close_reason: Implemented form builder interface with drag-and-drop support using @dnd-kit. Created Zustand store with immer middleware for state management, question sidebar with categorized types, builder canvas with sortable cards, live preview panel with responsive modes, autosave functionality, and API endpoints for form/question CRUD operations.

title: Database Schema & Drizzle ORM Setup
description:
## Overview
Design and implement the complete database schema for the Typeform Clone using Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL.

## Tech Stack
- **Database**: PostgreSQL
- **ORM**: Drizzle ORM
- **Migrations**: drizzle-kit

## Database Schema

### 1. Users & Authentication
```typescript
// User table (managed by BetterAuth, extended)
export const users = pgTable('users', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  email: varchar('email', { length: 255 }).notNull().unique(),
  emailVerified: boolean('email_verified').default(false),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }),
  image: text('image'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at').defaultNow(),
});

// Sessions (BetterAuth)
export const sessions = pgTable('sessions', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  userId: uuid('user_id').notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  token: text('token').notNull().unique(),
  expiresAt: timestamp('expires_at').notNull(),
  ipAddress: varchar('ip_address', { length: 45 }),
  userAgent: text('user_agent'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),
});

// Accounts (OAuth - BetterAuth)
export const accounts = pgTable('accounts', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  userId: uuid('user_id').notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  provider: varchar('provider', { length: 50 }).notNull(),
  providerAccountId: varchar('provider_account_id', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  accessToken: text('access_token'),
  refreshToken: text('refresh_token'),
  expiresAt: timestamp('expires_at'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),
});
```

### 2. Workspaces & Teams
```typescript
export const workspaces = pgTable('workspaces', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  slug: varchar('slug', { length: 100 }).notNull().unique(),
  ownerId: uuid('owner_id').notNull().references(() => users.id),
  logo: text('logo'),
  settings: jsonb('settings').default({}),
  plan: varchar('plan', { length: 50 }).default('free'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at').defaultNow(),
});

export const workspaceMembers = pgTable('workspace_members', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  workspaceId: uuid('workspace_id').notNull().references(() => workspaces.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  userId: uuid('user_id').notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  role: varchar('role', { length: 20 }).notNull().default('member'), // owner, admin, member
  invitedBy: uuid('invited_by').references(() => users.id),
  joinedAt: timestamp('joined_at').defaultNow(),
}, (table) => ({
  uniqueMember: unique().on(table.workspaceId, table.userId),
}));

export const workspaceInvitations = pgTable('workspace_invitations', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  workspaceId: uuid('workspace_id').notNull().references(() => workspaces.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  email: varchar('email', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  role: varchar('role', { length: 20 }).notNull().default('member'),
  token: varchar('token', { length: 100 }).notNull().unique(),
  invitedBy: uuid('invited_by').notNull().references(() => users.id),
  expiresAt: timestamp('expires_at').notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),
});
```

### 3. Forms
```typescript
export const forms = pgTable('forms', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  workspaceId: uuid('workspace_id').notNull().references(() => workspaces.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  createdBy: uuid('created_by').notNull().references(() => users.id),
  title: varchar('title', { length: 255 }).notNull().default('Untitled Form'),
  description: text('description'),
  slug: varchar('slug', { length: 100 }).notNull(),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 20 }).notNull().default('draft'), // draft, published, closed
  
  // Settings
  settings: jsonb('settings').default({
    showProgressBar: true,
    showQuestionNumbers: true,
    shuffleQuestions: false,
    oneQuestionPerPage: true,
  }),
  
  // Access Control
  isPublic: boolean('is_public').default(true),
  password: varchar('password', { length: 255 }),
  maxResponses: integer('max_responses'),
  closeAt: timestamp('close_at'),
  openAt: timestamp('open_at'),
  
  // Theming
  themeId: uuid('theme_id').references(() => themes.id),
  customTheme: jsonb('custom_theme'),
  
  // Metadata
  publishedAt: timestamp('published_at'),
  closedAt: timestamp('closed_at'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at').defaultNow(),
}, (table) => ({
  slugWorkspaceUnique: unique().on(table.workspaceId, table.slug),
}));

// Form versions for history
```

```typescript

  // Basic
  'short_text', 'long_text', 'email', 'phone', 'number', 'url', 'date', 'time',
  // Selection
  'multiple_choice', 'checkboxes', 'dropdown', 'picture_choice', 'yes_no',
  'rating', 'opinion_scale', 'nps', 'ranking', 'matrix',

  'file_upload', 'signature', 'video_recording', 'audio_recording',

  // Advanced
  'payment', 'calendly', 'address', 'legal', 'captcha',
]);

export const questions = pgTable('questions', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  formId: uuid('form_id').notNull().references(() => forms.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  type: questionTypeEnum('type').notNull(),
  title: text('title'),
  description: text('description'),
  placeholder: varchar('placeholder', { length: 255 }),

  // Type-specific settings

  // Media

export const questionGroups = pgTable('question_groups', {

// Multiple choice options
export const questionOptions = pgTable('question_options', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  questionId: uuid('question_id').notNull().references(() => questions.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
```

title: Project Setup & Infrastructure
description:
## Overview
Initialize the Typeform Clone project with Next.js 15, configure all tooling, and set up the development environment.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **UI Components**: Shadcn UI
- **Package Manager**: pnpm (recommended) or npm
- **Deployment**: Docker Compose

## Tasks

### 1. Project Initialization
- [ ] Create Next.js 15 project with App Router
- [ ] Configure TypeScript with strict mode
- [ ] Set up path aliases (@/ for src)
- [ ] Configure ESLint & Prettier
- [ ] Set up Husky for pre-commit hooks
- [ ] Configure lint-staged

### 2. Tailwind CSS Setup
- [ ] Install and configure Tailwind CSS
- [ ] Set up custom color palette (brand colors)
- [ ] Configure custom fonts
- [ ] Add animation utilities
- [ ] Set up dark mode support (class-based)

### 3. Shadcn UI Installation
- [ ] Initialize Shadcn UI
- [ ] Install core components:
  - [ ] Button, Input, Textarea
  - [ ] Card, Dialog, Sheet
  - [ ] Select, Checkbox, Radio
  - [ ] Toast, Alert, Badge
  - [ ] Dropdown Menu, Context Menu
  - [ ] Tabs, Accordion
  - [ ] Form (react-hook-form integration)
  - [ ] Skeleton, Spinner

### 4. Additional Dependencies
```bash
# State Management
pnpm add zustand

# Data Fetching
pnpm add @tanstack/react-query

# Drag and Drop
pnpm add @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @dnd-kit/utilities

# Animations
pnpm add framer-motion

# Forms & Validation
pnpm add react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod

# Date handling
pnpm add date-fns

# Icons
pnpm add lucide-react

# Database & ORM
pnpm add drizzle-orm postgres
pnpm add -D drizzle-kit

# Auth
pnpm add better-auth
```

### 5. Project Structure
```
src/
├── app/
│   ├── (auth)/
│   │   ├── login/
│   │   ├── register/
│   │   └── layout.tsx
│   ├── (dashboard)/
│   │   ├── forms/
│   │   ├── responses/
│   │   ├── analytics/
│   │   ├── settings/
│   │   └── layout.tsx
│   ├── (public)/
│   │   └── f/[formSlug]/      # Public form view
│   ├── api/
│   │   ├── auth/
│   │   ├── forms/
│   │   ├── questions/
│   │   ├── responses/
│   │   └── webhooks/
│   ├── layout.tsx
│   └── page.tsx
├── components/
│   ├── ui/                     # Shadcn components
│   ├── builder/                # Form builder components
│   ├── forms/                  # Form-related components
│   ├── shared/                 # Shared components
│   └── providers/              # Context providers
├── lib/
│   ├── db/
│   │   ├── schema.ts
│   │   ├── index.ts
│   │   └── migrations/
│   ├── auth/
│   ├── utils.ts
│   └── validations/
├── stores/                     # Zustand stores
├── hooks/                      # Custom hooks
├── types/                      # TypeScript types
├── styles/
│   └── globals.css
└── config/
    └── site.ts
```

### 6. Environment Configuration
```env
# .env.example
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/typeform_clone
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=your-secret-key
BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000

# Optional
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
AWS_S3_BUCKET=
```

### 7. Docker Setup
- [ ] Create Dockerfile for Next.js app
- [ ] Create docker-compose.yml with:
  - [ ] Next.js app service
  - [ ] PostgreSQL service
  - [ ] Redis service (optional, for sessions)
- [ ] Create docker-compose.dev.yml for development
- [ ] Add .dockerignore

### 8. Development Scripts
```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "next lint",
    "lint:fix": "next lint --fix",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate",
    "db:migrate": "drizzle-kit migrate",
    "db:push": "drizzle-kit push",
    "db:studio": "drizzle-kit studio",
    "docker:dev": "docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up",
    "docker:build": "docker-compose build",
    "docker:up": "docker-compose up -d"
  }
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Project runs with `pnpm dev`
- [ ] TypeScript strict mode enabled
- [ ] All Shadcn components installed and working
- [ ] Docker Compose starts all services
- [ ] Database connection works
- [ ] ESLint and Prettier configured
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks working

## Dependencies
None - this is the first issue

## Estimated Effort
Medium (1 day)
